id.description: One word: the name of the profession

name.description: The name shown to the player

skill.description: The name of the skill it trains

tools.description: Items needed to practise it (needed, not used up)

pillar.description: The pillar the profession feeds: trade or religion

day.description: The routine of the day: blocks of time, activity and place in the schedule format of the NPC classes (US-290)

from.description: The time the block starts, HH:MM

do.description: The activity: sleep, rest, eat, work, idle, go, patrol or a word the rules know

at.description: Where it happens: a named place of the level, or home

prefer.description: Weights for the tags of what a person could do while the block is in force, in whole percent (100 = neutral, 0 to 500): a clan member of this profession scores an action times the weight of each tag it carries (work, gather, hunt, sleep, warm, talk, gift, steal, rest, wander). A need in danger comes first

additionalProperties.description: The weight of this tag, in percent

night.description: The routine of the night, when it differs from the day
